reviews.title: 80 ROPS and yes it does perform better than a 4070 Super.
reviews.comment:
The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/E1b3C6x1AhL.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/613ar0njcuL._SY256.jpg This particular card isn’t the most beautiful on the market, but the cooling is amazing and the performance is much better than I expected. Simply plug and play. Can’t be any easier to install.
I had seen reviews claiming that the 5070 was no better than a 4070 super. I can assure you this particular 5070, is much better than a 4070 super. The particular game I have been struggling with using the 4070 super, plays with a much higher frame rate and this is without using frame generation, or some crazy form of DLSS.
Oh and this variation of the 5070 has all 80 ROPS.
If you’re looking for a decent price RTX 5070, this particular PNY is worth every penny. It is quiet even under max load.  I was even able to notice a difference in editing a video I made playing the game I mentioned earlier in record time.
Also, this card fits in my mini tower. (HP Z4-G4). It has a surprisingly small footprint and sips power.
You’re not gonna get this at MSRP, but just do it because it is the best 70 series card I have ever owned.
Thank you for reading friends.

reviews.title: Couldn't ask for a better 5070!
reviews.comment:
Excellent performance, super quite and cool!
There aren't a lot of reviews on these PNY cards but after some digging online I decided to give this one a chance and one of my son's needed an upgrade.
Card was packaged well and comes with the dual 8 pin to 12 pin connector.
The card is not too heavy and thus far the cooler is phenomenal. Card comes with an 8% overclock out of the box on the ARGB models but the cooling is so good the Nivida app was able to find additional headroom. Fans are super quite on this one, no issues as a few have noted with their cards.
Excellent performance at 1440p.
He has a small case for his build and until we got this card I had his AiO and fans on high to keep everything cool, this card dropped the temps significantly in the case to the point I was able to move the fans and pump back to quite. Frankly I'm impressed... so impressed actually I bought the Ti model for myself about 2 weeks later. (will review that as well)
RGB looks fantastic as well if you are into that.
I had concerned when I ordered about compatibility but it wasn't an issue at all. This was installed into a B650 board running the latest bios and a 5700x with 32GB of DDR4 3600. Used a display driver to remove the other drivers before install, shut down, installed the new card and was good to go as I already had the Nvidia drivers downloaded.
If you are looking for a quite card with RGB and excellent performance don't pass this by, especially for the price!

reviews.title: Amazing graphics card!
reviews.comment: The PNY NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 12GB is amazing, very easy installation. It comes with a 12pin to 2x8 pin splitter, so its compatible with 750w Fully Modular PSUs. Install the correct graphics card drivers online and you're good to go. Make sure this GPU fits with your case before you buy it!
reviews.author: Jackson Zenisek

reviews.title: 5070 that absolutely slaps for 1440p
reviews.comment: This PNY RTX 5070 is kind of a sweet spot card. 1440p is where it really shines, pushing high FPS in most modern titles, especially when you flip on DLSS and frame gen. Thermals and power draw are under control, so you’re not cooking your case while you grind ranked. For the money, it’s killer value versus older 70‑class cards and still hangs with a 4070 Super while usually being cheaper, makes it a super solid pick for a mid‑range gaming rig or upgrade from a 20/30‑series card
